data.title: Tiler
data.summary: The role involves complete wet-room renovations, including demolition, preparation, waterproofing, tiling, fixture installation and finishing. Work takes place at changing customer sites.

requirements.text: Experience in tiling and waterproofing work
Ability to work independently and systematically
requirements.question: What does 'ability to work independently and systematically' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for independent and systematic work without describing what this involves.

requirements.text: Careful workmanship and good problem-solving skills
requirements.question: What does 'careful workmanship and good problem-solving skills' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting requests careful workmanship and problem-solving skills without giving a practical example.

requirements.question: What does 'customer-service-oriented attitude' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for a customer-service-oriented attitude without describing the expected conduct.

requirements.text: Access to a car for travel between work sites
Good spoken and comprehension skills in Finnish
requirements.question: Is Finnish needed from day one, or could someone start in English and build up Finnish on the job?
requirements.why: The posting requires good spoken and comprehension skills in Finnish.
